input.summary: Confirm Client ownership of Client data and Support Services work product, with a licence-back of embedded TrueLink IP
input.comment: [Playbook] We own what we put in and what we pay for: Client Content, Client Intellectual Property, borrower/applicant data and the work product of the Support Services should remain ours, with a perpetual royalty-free licence to any TrueLink IP embedded in that work product. TrueLink keeps ownership of the Interface itself.

ops.oldText: d. Ownership. Notwithstanding the license granted under section 2.1, TrueLink retains all of its ownership and license rights in the Interface.
ops.newText: d. Ownership. Notwithstanding the license granted under section 2.1, TrueLink retains all of its ownership and license rights in the Interface. Client retains all right, title and interest in and to the Client Content, Client Intellectual Property and all borrower, loan applicant and other Client data submitted to or generated through the Interface or the Web Site, and nothing herein assigns or transfers any such rights to TrueLink. All results and work product of the Support Services prepared for Client are the property of Client, and TrueLink hereby assigns such work product to Client and grants Client a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free license to use, modify and sublicense any TrueLink Intellectual Property embedded therein. No jointly owned intellectual property is created under this Agreement.

input.summary: Extend the licence to Client affiliates and contractors and make it transferable to a successor
input.comment: [Playbook] The licence must cover our affiliates and the contractors and correspondent brokers acting on our behalf (as contemplated by the recitals) and must transfer to a successor in an M&A transaction; it should be terminable only in accordance with this Agreement, not at TrueLink's discretion.

ops.oldText: a. Grant. TrueLink hereby grants to Client a non-exclusive license to use the Interface in the ordinary course of its business of the origination, underwriting, processing and funding of consumer finance receivables in accordance with this Agreement.
ops.newText: a. Grant. TrueLink hereby grants to Client, its affiliates and its contractors and correspondent brokers acting on its behalf a non-exclusive license to use the Interface in the ordinary course of its business of the origination, underwriting, processing and funding of consumer finance receivables in accordance with this Agreement. The license is transferable to a successor of Client by merger, acquisition or sale of all or substantially all of its assets, and may not be revoked or suspended except upon termination of this Agreement in accordance with its terms.
